text: And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
“Dominion and dread [are] with Him, the One making peace in His high places.
Is there a number to His troops? And upon whom does His light not arise?
So how can a man be righteous with God? Or what can be pure [that] is born of a woman?
Behold, even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in His eyes.
How much less a man—a maggot, and a son of man—a worm!”
